principle: One useful commercial option per need is better than a wall of affiliate links. ERN chooses a small utility stack and only activates exact links after manual verification.

primaryStack.reason: Among currently owner-visible link-generation programs, Yesim has the strongest observed commercial terms (18% displayed reward, 90-day cookie). Product/coverage fit still needs a normal visitor-utility review before public activation.
Keep Welcome Pickups where already useful; use Kiwitaxi only for destinations with no useful Welcome Pickups coverage.
Use only for places where self-driving materially improves the trip. Never stack several rental brands on one destination.
Distinct from tours: useful for major city attraction bundles. Current priority places: New York, London, Chicago, Sydney.
Use as a coverage fallback where Klook/Viator/Tiqets are weak rather than duplicating them everywhere.
Useful only for major-city arrival/departure contexts; should not appear on nature/resort destinations.

avoidClutterRules: No more than one eSIM option by default.
No more than one car-rental option by default.
Do not show a transfer partner when the place has no realistic airport/city-transfer need.
Do not duplicate the same intent merely because another affiliate program is available.
Affiliate reward rate never affects source ranking or featured-camera order.
